description: This file contains JavaScript code for managing menu interactions and animations, including functions for toggling submenus and handling transition effects in the navigation menu.

methods.name: resetHeightAfterAnimation(item)
methods.description: Sets the element's height to 'auto' after a transition completes to allow for proper submenu expansion.

methods.name: findNavItem(start)
methods.description: Finds the closest parent element with the class 'Nav__item' starting from a given element.

methods.name: toggleSubMenu(ev)
methods.description: Toggles the display of a submenu when a navigation item is clicked, handling height animations and class toggling.
